description: [Sign-in required] Reads the connected account’s wedding — costs no credits and returns the date, venue, budget, guest count and theme in a `writable` half (exactly the fields update_wedding accepts, under the same names) plus a `derived` half with days remaining, guest totals and checklist progress. A member’s role decides what comes back: the budget is omitted for a role without budget:view.
